verdict: NO BLOCKING COLLISION. One ordering dependency (F3) and three soft overlaps with sibling trainer PRs, all reconcilable.

dependencies.detail: T2's weakness-steered MIX in the selection cascade reuses F3's steerFromWeakness / WeaknessSteer. F3 also makes weaknessCounters a live read (A3 inserts a steered branch in loadNext between personal and curated). T2 builds the user-facing toggle ON TOP of that branch. Resolution: build F3 first (architecture DAG Phase 0 -> Phase 2). If T2 is built before F3 lands, the 'Mixed (weakness-steered)' option degrades gracefully to plain mixed (source:undefined) — spec gates the steered call behind 'typeof steerFromWeakness === function'-style presence, i.e. behind F3.

sibling_overlaps.detail: T1 owns the MISS path (solution reveal + why). T2 owns the SOLVE path after-solve provenance ('the win you left') + the PRE-puzzle provenance line + the mode toggle/picker + exhaustion msg. Distinct moments. Shared file but non-overlapping blocks. Land order-independent; if both touch loadNext, the steered branch (F3/T1-adjacent) and the source-toggle branch (T2) compose.
T3 owns recording integrity + retention header. T2 does not touch finish()/recording. No conflict.
T2 consumes motifLabelOrRaw (shipped). If F1's labelOrRaw lands first, T2 prefers it. Either way T2 adds severity.* keys (its own). No collision.
